blocks.title: A quiet reader for active learning
blocks.description: Import a copy of a PDF, Markdown or TXT file, choose a configured Vetta model, and ask about selected passages without leaving the reader.

items.title: Library first
items.description: Materials are copied into private plugin storage before reading.

items.title: Selection actions
items.description: Ask, explain, translate, add pinyin or record a thought only after selecting text; AI answers go straight to reading records.

items.title: Notes that stay yours
items.description: Highlights and AI answers are saved with their location and can be exported by material title.
